description: Source code for HttpDownloader class in Kotlin, handling HTTP file downloads with cache validation, ETag, and resumable download support.

classes.name: HttpDownloader
classes.description: A Kotlin class for downloading files over HTTP with support for cache validation, resumable downloads, and handling various HTTP headers.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedError; intended to get InputStream for download.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Suspending function to fetch bytes from HTTP, handling 404 errors.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs HTTP HEAD request, checks ETag and other headers, and decides whether to download or skip.

methods.name: downloadToFile
methods.description: Handles the actual file download, supporting resumable downloads and retries.

methods.name: totalDownloadSize
methods.description: Returns total size of the download, or -1 if unknown.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Indicates if the file has changed since last download (deprecated).
